svg.aria-label: scripts/init-env.sh: Copy .env.example to .env. Fill each empty password with a random value. docker compose up --wait: Build the WAF, start the stack, return when all services are healthy. tests/stack/stack_test.sh: Check health, WAF blocks, limits and fail-closed behaviour. docker compose --profile ollama up --wait: Also start Ollama for local models. Off by default
